summary.text: Andrew Mathews is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 27 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Brandon Van Dover.
He works as a caseworker and has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Mathews received a law degree from Oak Brook College of Law in 2016.
His Ballotpedia profile lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2017 and his current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, his 2016 campaign website highlighted creating jobs by rolling back taxes and regulations.
